fresh_rotten_fruits.name: Fresh and Rotten Fruits Dataset
fresh_rotten_fruits.blocker: Mendeley Data requires browser-based download with JavaScript rendering. No direct download API available without authentication.
fresh_rotten_fruits.expected_files: ZIP archive containing 16 class directories (fresh/rotten x 8 fruits)
fresh_rotten_fruits.citation: Sultana, Nusrat; Jahan, Musfika; Uddin, Mohammad Shorif (2022). Fresh and Rotten Fruits Dataset. Mendeley Data, V1.
fresh_rotten_fruits.manual_download_instructions:
1. Visit https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/bdd69gyhv8/1
2. Click the 'Download' button
3. Save the ZIP file to data/raw/fruits/
4. Extract the archive
5. Run: python -m ml.pipelines.validate_datasets
